meaning: Form in which the link is enforced
value_or_range: sufficient form: admission cap on the upper entry cohort
notes: Because upper completion = m*adm_upper(t-3)*surv (surv < 1), the admission cap implies the completion-level statement; the implied ratio is then audited (0/53 violations required).

meaning: Check (a-i) unfilled-share floor
value_or_range: unfilled_share_O >= 0.10 in >= 15 of 30 scored (t,L) cells, 2010-2024 x {lower, upper}
notes: THRESHOLD, not a parameter. Round declared bar above the 10% non-triviality line. (a) is a REPRESENTATION check (see PRE_DECLARATIONS sec.6 a, sec.9).

meaning: Check (a-ii) high-gate excess-demand bar
value_or_range: queue_ratio_H = A_H/K_H >= 1.10 in >= 15 of the same 30 cells
notes: THRESHOLD, not a parameter.

meaning: Check (a-iii) same-country-year coexistence count
value_or_range: >= 8 of 15 years 2010-2024 with (a-i) and (a-ii) both holding AND p4 <= 0.50
notes: THRESHOLD. p4 = rung4_emp/rung4_demand; V8 median 0.151 (SYNTHESIS_022.md:108), so the p4 leg is expected to hold and is not the discriminating leg.

meaning: Check (a-iv) same-level coexistence statistic
value_or_range: same_level(t) = 1[spare_upper(t)>0]*1[rationed_official(upper,t)>0]; count over 2010-2024 must be 0 in arm A01 and >= 8 in arm A11
notes: spare_upper = seats_upper - enrolment_upper. Structural contrast, scoped to three declared absences: no declined-place object, no school-gate rationing, no demand attached to a binding gate. NOT a claim that the frozen model has no unused capacity (it has 0.1418 of cohort spare at upper 2024).

meaning: Check (b-i) primary near-universal band
value_or_range: first sustained >= 90 in 2014-2020; primary 2024 >= 92 (no upper bound: the m=1.10 convention clips at 100.0, so saturation is not scored as an overshoot)
notes: THRESHOLD, carried verbatim from the frozen v1.2 band so v1.5 is scored on the same signature, not a band drawn around its own output.

meaning: Check (b-ii) upper-secondary stall band
value_or_range: upper < 90 in every year <= 2024; upper 2024 in [55,85]
notes: THRESHOLD. [55,85] admits both the v1.2 band [73,77] and the kappa-implied ceiling 63.9695.

meaning: Check (b-iii) endpoint placement band (reported, not verdict-bearing)
notes: THRESHOLD. Pre-freeze arithmetic: kappa*67.4073 = 63.9695, so (b-iii) is expected FALSE and (b) expected MIXED.

meaning: Check (c-i) shadow placement ratio
notes: THRESHOLD. v1.3 baseline D_g2(2020)/D_g0(2020) = 0.2606/0.0128 = 20.4x, so this leg is largely structural; (c-iii) is the discriminating leg.

meaning: Check (c-ii) open-tier shadow ceiling
notes: THRESHOLD, reused verbatim from the frozen v1.3 c3 ceiling. No threshold moved.

meaning: Check (c-iii) gate-pressure asymmetry
value_or_range: R->2R at the high gate raises D_H >= +10.0 pp; the same doubling at the open tier raises D_O <= +1.0 pp
notes: THRESHOLD (the +10.0 pp leg is the v1.3 c1(ii) bar applied to the anchor type only; the <=+1.0 pp open-tier leg is new and declared here).

meaning: Check (d-i) no free taste / no level shim
value_or_range: w_work_free = 0 in both tiers and the outside option; T-AUD-1/2 hits = 0
notes: Audit clause (mirror of shadow c4c). A hit is (d) = FAIL.

meaning: Check (d-ii) pattern under the cap
value_or_range: upper < 90 every year <= 2024; slack_t = kappa*lower(t-3) - upper_t >= 0 in all 53 scored anchor cells; cap NON-BINDING (adm_upper unchanged) in >= 5 of 53 cells
notes: THRESHOLD. 53 cells = t 1973-2025; 1970-1972 NOT-SCORABLE. Because the cap is a sufficient form and surv < 1, strict slack > 0 is mechanical whenever it binds; the informative leg is the non-binding count (v1.3 had 20/53 binding cells, all 2006-2025).

meaning: Check (d-iii) outside-option responsiveness
value_or_range: w_child -> 1.10*w_child lowers upper completion_uis(2024) by >= 2.0 pp
notes: THRESHOLD. The 2.0 pp bar is a DECLARED comparative-static bar, not a derived one. This is the leg that decides whether the pattern is pipeline-stipulated or outside-option-carried.

meaning: Check (d-iv) Tier O quality is an equilibrium
value_or_range: q_O_mult -> 0.80*q_O_mult raises unfilled_share_O by >= 5.0 pp (mean 2010-2024, lower+upper)
notes: THRESHOLD. If take-up does not respond to Tier O quality, Tier O is not an equilibrium object and (d) is at best MIXED.

meaning: Check (e-i) no-refit guard: bimodal OFF + kappa OFF
notes: The v1.4 convention is verified on disk: generator_v1_4_demand/results/_ablation/synthetic_panel_v1_4_demand_off.csv hashes 47d4b082... (same value). A mismatch => BASELINE-GUARD-FAIL, A11 result INVALID.
